SMTO-CFG-0025 — Saved model is unavailable

GUID: de719d8d-3525-46a7-b700-796b02e831d4
Slug: composer-model-unavailable
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • This conversation was set to use a model that SMTO no longer offers, for example because it was removed or renamed in the model setup. New messages can't start until a working model is chosen. Tasks already started keep their model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and check that the Main card shows a model that is available. If you change it, select Save Main. New messages use the model chosen there, so it must be one SMTO can actually use.
  2. Go back to the conversation, reload the page and send your message again. Reloading picks up the current model choices instead of the missing one.
  3. If it still fails, select New chat in the Conversations pane and send your message there. A new conversation has no older saved choices, so it uses the model setup as it is now.

What success looks like

  • Your message starts a task without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO, saying which model you expected. Don't keep resending; the message will be refused until an available model is chosen.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The composer rejected the submission because the conversation's saved model is not among the models the current model configuration offers.

What this means

  • The chosen llm_model is absent from the current model configuration's advertised option values. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • The chosen llm_model is absent from the current model configuration's advertised option values.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the exact selection with current model options; this check does not contact the provider or prove a model outage.

How to fix it

  • Select a model currently offered by the model configuration (Settings › Setup › Model routing, Main role) for new work; existing and resumed tasks keep their captured model. If the conversation's saved composer profile still names a removed model, start a new conversation rather than editing the stored profile.
  • Choose an available model for the new task before sending. Resumed tasks retain their captured model.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A currently advertised model is selected for new work.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
